Azeroth Survivors download and first-run fixes

Before you download

We do not host game files, mirrors, modified executables, trainers or "unlock all" saves. Official entry point only; see the safety page for how to spot lookalikes.

  • Safety check

Browser version

The maintained way to play is the browser build on Aethus's own site. You need Chrome or Edge on desktop, WebGPU enabled, and patience on first load. The game caches the world locally, so the first pull is the slow one; after that, repeat opens are faster. If the loader reports no WebGPU, update the browser and check that hardware acceleration is on — do not download a "fix" from a third-party site for this.

  • Play on Aethus’s site

Windows version

A Windows build exists for players who would rather not keep a browser tab pinned. It is distributed through the developer's own channels. Treat any.rarnamed after the game on a third-party domain as unverified: the filename pattern has been circulated by mirror and aggregator sites, not by the developer. We do not link to or host it.

Fixes: black screen

Black screen at launch is almost always a WebGPU or focus problem, not a corrupted install. Close other GPU-heavy tabs, confirm hardware acceleration, reload once, click inside the canvas after the loader finishes. If the screen stays black after the loader clears, switch from Chrome to Edge or vice versa before you try anything more drastic.

Fixes: slow first load

The first resource pull is the largest. A slow first load is not a symptom of a bad download; repeated reloading restarts the cache and makes it slower. Leave the tab open until the in-game prompt appears.

Fixes: no WebGPU

If the loader reports no WebGPU, update the browser and check that hardware acceleration is on — do not download a "fix" from a third-party site for this.
